verses.literal: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father of us and in the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.dgt: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.greek: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.dgt: We ought to thank God always for you, brothers and sisters, as is fitting, because your faith is growing exceedingly and the love of each one of all of you toward one another is increasing.
